question: The Government’s flagship programme ‘Make in India’ completed how many years on September 25, 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**8 years.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **'Make in India'** completed **8 years **on **September 25, 2022**.
 
• 'Make in India' is a** flagship programme** launched by the** Government of India** in **September 2014 **to encourage** domestic and foreign companies** to manufacture their products in India.
 
• The programme aims to **boost the manufacturing sector **and create **job opportunities** in India. 
 
• In the last 8 years, the programme has attracted **significant investments** in various sectors such as **automobiles, electronics, defence, and pharmaceuticals.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1 -** '5 years' is** incorrect** as it refers to the completion of the programme in 2019.
 
• **Option 2** - '9 years' and **option 3** - '4 years' are also** incorrect** as they do not match with the timeline of the programme.
 
• Hence, the **correct **answer is option 4 - '8 years'.
